scope: Kämmerei + one selected Fachbereich; internal/VPN; local TOTP; synthetic data only

scenarios.title: Password and TOTP enrollment
scenarios.steps: Operator authorizes enrollment of a disposable Kämmerei account. Sign in with password, open a contract URL before MFA, enroll in a test authenticator, submit current code, sign out and attempt replay.
scenarios.expected: Password alone exposes no register; valid current code opens own scope; replay rejected; no seed/code in shared evidence.

scenarios.title: Department isolation and permissions
scenarios.steps: Sign in using separate browser profiles for Kämmerei and selected Fachbereich. Open own and other department contract/document IDs; try account administration and an unauthorized edit.
scenarios.expected: Own scope available; foreign metadata/content hidden; administrative and business permissions follow provisional matrix. No infrastructure/Judith grants.

scenarios.title: Create a synthetic service contract
scenarios.steps: Create SYN-PILOT-FB-001 for fictional equipment maintenance, synthetic contact, explicit manual start/end/task dates. Enter amount unknown, then a separate known zero case.
scenarios.expected: Saved fields persist; owner fixed to authorized department; zero differs from unknown; pending-rule notice visible; no authoritative financial/deadline claim.

scenarios.title: Create own synthetic case and cross-scope search
scenarios.steps: Create SYN-PILOT-KAM-001 with fictional rental data. Search/filter/list/report/export from each department profile.
scenarios.expected: Each profile sees only permitted records; counts/export agree; no foreign record or unconfirmed calculation treated as approved.

scenarios.title: Edit and stale-tab conflict
scenarios.steps: Open own case in two tabs, edit description in first, then submit an older version in second.
scenarios.expected: First edit persists and history identifies actor/time/changed fields; stale update conflicts and does not overwrite.

scenarios.title: Document quarantine, retry and verified download
scenarios.steps: Upload inert PDF and synthetic text; with operator-controlled scanner outage verify quarantine/no download; restore scanner and run bounded retry. Download bytes, replace document and inspect predecessor.
scenarios.expected: Only scanned/hash-verified clean bytes download; range cannot bypass quarantine; retry idempotent; predecessor/history preserved; no actual municipal documents.

scenarios.title: Actual scanner synthetic detection
scenarios.steps: Use approved maintained ClamAV with official current signatures. Run REQUIRE_REAL_CLAMAV test: clean synthetic text/PDF and in-memory EICAR; inspect HTTP denied infected download.
scenarios.expected: Actual clean and infected outcomes, current version/definition evidence and HTTP gates pass. Simulated scanner is explicitly insufficient.

scenarios.title: Independent assigned review
scenarios.steps: Writer requests completeness review; authorized account administrator configures eligible independent assignee with existing read scope. Reviewer decides with reason; attempt self-decision and stale decision; materially edit content and inspect invalidation.
scenarios.expected: Only correctly scoped assigned independent reviewer decides current content; self/stale/wrong-recipient rejected; material edit invalidates earlier approval. Completeness decision supplies no accounting/legal determination.

scenarios.title: Archive and audit history
scenarios.steps: After reviewed synthetic case, open archive confirmation, cancel once, then explicitly confirm. Attempt contract/task/document/review edits; inspect history and authorized download.
scenarios.expected: Cancel preserves state; confirmation makes entire record read-only while retaining history/content and scoped visibility. No deletion or ordinary unarchive.

scenarios.title: Recovery and local monitoring
scenarios.steps: Rehearse encrypted database/document backup to new disposable target; compare IDs/history/hash/MFA/access; exercise stale/failed job and DB-unavailable health.
scenarios.expected: Consistent restore and scoped checks pass; unhealthy state observed; no external notification/escrow; measure local recovery without asserting scheduled off-host RPO.

scenarios.title: Browser accessibility and usability
scenarios.steps: Exercise keyboard-only navigation, skip link, error recovery, 320/390-pixel reflow and approved screen reader; navigate complete reminder pages and compare full counts.
scenarios.expected: Usable focus/labels/errors/reflow and complete pagination; record actual assistive technology/browser version and issues. Automation does not constitute manual AT acceptance.

scenarios.title: Acceptance boundary and release record
scenarios.steps: Review source/artifact/evidence and role scope with Kämmerei representative and selected users. Record every case actual result, participant role, timestamp and evidence reference.
scenarios.expected: No NOT_RUN/BLOCKED/FAILED becomes accepted. Synthetic pilot acceptance remains separate from real-data authorization, independent review and municipal production approval.
